question: **After reading the passage it can be inferred that soap was first made by:**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Babylonians**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• It is said in the** first sentence of the first paragraph** of the given passage that *"An excavation of ancient Babylon revealed evidence that Babylonians were making soap around 2800 B.C."*
 
• From here we can say that* **S*****oap was first made by the Babylonians.**

​Hence, the correct answer is option 4.
